findings.highlight: I did my best to find you an Azoth Blade similar to the Jeweled Sword, and Illya will be supporting your Projection. If this goes well, we won't be able to replicate the original, but we should get something with about half of its power."
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣と、士郎の投影とイリヤのサポート。うまくいけばオリジナルの複製とはいかないけど、半分ぐらいは能力の再現ができる筈よ」
findings.governingReading: Rin supplies an Azoth sword deliberately made as like the jeweled sword as possible, combined with Projection and support.
findings.explanation: Azoth modeled on jeweled sword becomes found similar blade.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. Let's go back to my room, then. You need a quiet place for the best chance of success."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうね。それじゃ部屋に戻りましょう。落ち着いた場所じゃないと成功率が落ちるでしょ」
findings.governingReading: Rin proposes returning to a calm room and immediately turns toward the living room.
findings.explanation: Return to room becomes return to Rin's own room.

findings.highlight: But she doesn't deny that she's the person most likely to make careless mistakes.
findings.evidenceJa: 反論しないあたり、本人もここ一番でドジをかます可能性を否定できないらしい。
findings.governingReading: Her lack of rebuttal suggests she cannot deny possible mistakes at the crucial moment.
findings.explanation: Crucial-moment clumsiness becomes highest comparative likelihood.

findings.highlight: "Rin, if you want the replicate the Jeweled Sword, then don't come in until I tell you to. I'll call you if it seems like an accident's about to happen, but unless that happens, stay outside, no matter what."
findings.evidenceJa: 「リン。宝石剣を複製したいのなら、わたしがいいって言うまで入ってこないで。事故が起きそうになったら声をかけるから、それまで、何があっても外にいるのよ」
findings.governingReading: Illya conditions the instruction on wanting the sword replicated.
findings.explanation: Want the replicate instead of want to replicate.

findings.highlight: "But Illya, from what I've seen, Archer only Projects specific weapons. I don't have any information about the Jeweled Sword. Even if I have blueprints and a similar example, I can't replicate it."
findings.evidenceJa: 「けどイリヤ。俺は自分で見たものか、アーチャーが作った事のある武器しか投影できない。宝石剣とやらの情報は皆無だ。いくら宝石剣に真似た短剣と元になる設計図があっても、宝石剣は複製できないぞ」
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he can Project only what he personally saw or weapons Archer has previously made; a blueprint and imitated dagger alone are insufficient.
findings.explanation: Shirou's two permitted Projection sources become Archer's habits.

findings.highlight: There's no pain. My pain perception plunges into layers of spinning pain, but it's eroded by damage to my body which doesn't correspond to the pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みのない、痛みという認識はもはや該当しない自己の損傷に蝕まれながら、何重にも回転する痛みの中に落ちていく。
findings.governingReading: Boy falls into layered revolving pain while self-damage eats him, damage to which even recognition as pain no longer applies.
findings.explanation: Damage beyond the concept of pain becomes mismatched bodily pain perception.

findings.highlight: It's like I'm looking out across the landscape of Arizona through a huge telescope.
findings.evidenceJa: アリゾナの荒野に独りきりで回る、大きな大きな観測装置に酷似している。
findings.governingReading: The enormous circuit resembles an enormous observation apparatus rotating alone in the Arizona wilderness.
findings.explanation: The circuit's resemblance to a huge rotating observatory becomes a view of Arizona through a telescope, changing the image used to describe the ritual structure.

findings.highlight: I cut my consciousness off from the excess. Because I cut my mind, my body becomes half its size.
findings.evidenceJa: 余分な事に意識を割いた。意識を割いたから、体が半分になった。
findings.governingReading: He gave part of his attention to unnecessary things; because attention was divided, his perceived body halved.
findings.explanation: Diverting attention to extraneous matters becomes cutting attention away from them.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. To be exact, it's the Multi-Dimensional Phenomenon: Jeweled Sword Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ええ。正しく言うのなら多重次元屈折現象、宝石剣キシュア・ゼルレッチ・シュバインオーグ。
findings.governingReading: Formal description is 多重次元屈折現象, multidimensional refraction phenomenon.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. But Zelretch is an eccentric who interacts with the everyday world especially often for a Magician, so he has other disciples.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうよ。けどゼルレッチは魔法使いの中でも頻繁に俗世に関わる変人だから、弟子は他にもいるでしょうね。
findings.governingReading: Illya infers with でしょうね that frequent worldly interactions likely mean other disciples.
findings.explanation: Likely other disciples becomes unqualified other disciples.

findings.evidenceJa: —いや、使わなくてはいけない。
findings.governingReading: Boy corrects can manage another to must use it, to save Sakura by a method different from Rin's.
findings.explanation: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.

findings.governingReading: Japanese fragment is still bounded by opening and closing dialogue brackets.

findings.highlight: "Don't give me that. Illya and I are going to try something, so settle down and—hey, what's happened to your hand!?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「遠坂、じゃないわよ。わたしとイリヤは試し打ちをしてくるから、士郎は少しでも体を休めて—って、どうしたのよその手……！」
findings.governingReading: Rin and Illya plan a trial firing or test of the new weapon and ask boy to rest.

findings.highlight: I disconnect my mind and realize that she's holding my bloody right hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識が断線して、いつのまにか血塗れの右手を掴まれていた。
findings.governingReading: Consciousness breaks, and before he knows it Rin has taken his bloody hand despite seeming slow.
findings.explanation: Involuntary consciousness interruption becomes deliberate disconnection.

findings.highlight: To a jewel-user like Tohsaka, this is probably an everyday sight. But she's so pretty, I bet an accessory like this would really liven her up.
findings.evidenceJa: 宝石使いである遠坂にはこじんまりとした物だが、遠坂は美人なんだから、こういう小物の方が本人を引き立たせていいと思う。
findings.governingReading: Pendant is small or modest for a jewel-user like Rin and can accent her beauty.

findings.highlight: "No, they're not. Mine's empty, but yours still has a little left in it. It isn't enough to use for anything, but... It has meaning because it was used."
findings.evidenceJa: 「違うわ。わたしのは空っぽだけど、士郎のは少しだけ残ってる。取るに足りない量だけど、それでも、使われたからには意味があるんだわ」
findings.governingReading: Boy's pendant retains a little insignificant mana, and its having been used is meaningful.
findings.explanation: Negligible remaining amount becomes below every use threshold.
